intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the in-process Rust route's lexical declaration/reference link and unresolved-name record without making a semantic or trust claim.
success_criteria: binding_report.json has profile mumei.rust-lexical-bindings/v1, a reference span for answer linked by binding_id to its in-file declaration, and unresolved missing_name with no matching binding.

steps.name: Inspect Rust lexical binding metadata
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent rust-bindings --pointer-width 64 {root_dir}/scenarios/rust_bindings/demo_bindings.rs > {output_dir}/binding_report.json && {mumei_agent_python} -c "import json,pathlib; report=json.load(open('{output_dir}/binding_report.json')); source=pathlib.Path('{root_dir}/scenarios/rust_bindings/demo_bindings.rs').read_text(); declaration=next(item for item in report['bindings'] if item['name']=='answer'); assert report['profile']=='mumei.rust-lexical-bindings/v1', report; assert source[declaration['span']['start']:declaration['span']['end']]=='answer', report; assert any(item['binding_id']==declaration['id'] and source[item['span']['start']:item['span']['end']]=='answer' for item in report['references']), report; assert any(item['name']=='missing_name' for item in report['unresolved']), report; assert not any(item['name']=='missing_name' for item in report['bindings']), report; print('profile=mumei.rust-lexical-bindings/v1; answer resolved; missing_name unresolved')"
steps.artifact_contract: binding_report.json contains the observed Rust route profile, an answer reference linked to the in-file declaration, and unresolved missing_name.
steps.verifier_gate: Assertions require the exact versioned profile, matching declaration/reference binding IDs and spans, and missing_name only in unresolved.
